# National SC/MP (INS8060)

<!-- Generated by `cargo xtask docs` from `crates/isa/src/scmp.rs`. Edits here are overwritten; change the spec instead. -->

46 mnemonics, 121 encoded forms, operands little-endian. Generated from [`crates/isa/src/scmp.rs`](https://github.com/asm198x/asm198x/blob/main/crates/isa/src/scmp.rs).

Cycle counts show the base cost; `+p` is an extra cycle when an
indexed access crosses a page boundary, `+t` when a branch is taken.

## Provenance

This specification was authored from the following, in the family's primary reference library:

- *SC/MP Technical Description, 4200079A* — National Semiconductor (`by-topic/cpu-scmp/`)

Not from any emulator's decode loop: an emulator is a reading of the hardware, and this is meant to be a reading of the documentation.
